metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins from cbs Corporate Business Solutions.

plugins.name: cds-guard
plugins.description: Sets up @cbs-consulting/cds-guard in CAP and UI5 projects and keeps coding agents from changing protected CDS entities, annotations, code blocks and files by accident.

plugins.name: container-features
plugins.description: Sets up the cbs Dev Container Features in SAP BTP, CAP and Fiori projects: picks the Features a project needs, writes devcontainer.json and connects private npm feeds without committing tokens.

plugins.name: container-templates
plugins.description: Starts new SAP BTP projects from the cbs Dev Container Templates and helps when the container or the generator does not start.
